question: Averaged over every cell, did each region pair's coupling change from Precon1 to Precon4?
method: per rat, the mean of its Precon4 − Precon1 deltas over the cells of a view; one-sample t across rats (k − 1 df, two-sided); Benjamini–Hochberg across region pairs within each view; tested only with k ≥ 3 rats
